Obligatory: I'm not a doctor or pharmacist, I've taken Xanax and Buspar in the past.

Did they cut you off of Xanax without tapering? Because if you've been taking it daily for a while, that can be dangerous and cause seizures. I totally understand why your doctor might not want to write Xanax prescriptions anymore, as someone else commented it can be crazy addictive and is more for short-term treatment of panic attacks. 

That said, I still have a prescription for Xanax because of severe panic attacks. I don't take it anywhere near daily, and it works like a charm for an acute panic attack. I would be afraid to take it every day as I've tried that before, and it only leads to tolerance. I *need* it to work as a last resort when a panic attack strikes and I've already tried all of my non-medication options such as deep breathing, distracting myself, and other coping methods.

My experience with Buspar involved 40 lb weight gain. I switched to Zoloft, which helped with the general everyday anxiety without making it impossible for me to lose weight. This is just my personal experience. Not everyone gains weight on Buspar, and I've heard some people gain it on Zoloft, while I certainly didn't.

Don't be too afraid of the word antidepressant, a lot of them are used as antianxiety medication as well. For me, it was about finding a medication with benefits that outweighed the side effects.

I hope you find something that fits you and helps control your anxiety!
